verses.text: We’re writing about what existed from the beginning, what we’ve heard, what we’ve seen with our eyes, what we looked at, and what our hands touched—the Word of life.
This life was revealed, and we’ve seen it. We testify to it and announce to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
We announce what we’ve seen and heard to you too, so you can share fellowship with us. Our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
We’re writing these things so our joy may be complete.
Here’s the message we heard from him and announce to you: God is light, and there’s no darkness in him at all.
If we say we share fellowship with him while living in darkness, we’re lying and not living by the truth.
But if we live in the light, as he is in the light, we share fellowship with one another, and Jesus’ blood, his Son, cleanses us from every sin.
If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth isn’t in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
If we say we haven’t sinned, we make him out to be a liar, and his word isn’t in us.
